specialRules.ruleFull: Halflings move through any woodland terrain without penalty.
A Halfling riding a draft horse, a warhorse or anything larger than a mule or mountain goat moves 2" less than normal.
Halfling Heroes have +1 when rolling to find Rare items that aren't available only to Halflings.
Any warrior of the warband may run or charge while climbing.
The warband may hire only Ogres, as bouncers, and other Halflings.
Warriors within 6" of the Burgermeister may take Leadership tests on his Leadership.
The Quartermaster adds 2" to the range of any thrown weapon and 4" to a sling's.

Before each battle the Chef takes a Leadership test. If he passes, his pot holds stew to heal as many Wounds as he passed by, +1 (a roll of 7 against his Ld 8 heals up to 2 Wounds). Friendly models who sup it recover Wounds, none above its maximum.

At the end of each battle, whether or not any Thief fought, roll a D6.

D6 | Result
1 | Stop Thief!: remove one Thief from the roster, with every Treasure in your stash from earlier games. Add no additional Treasures if any Thieves remain in the warband.
2-5 | Tax Time: the Thieves take their usual fees when Treasures are sold, as normal.
6 | Ignorance is Bliss: the Thieves waive their fees, and don't count towards the warband's size when Treasures are sold.

Thieves may infiltrate, as the Infiltration skill: they set up after the enemy warband, anywhere out of its sight and more than 12" from any enemy model. If both sides infiltrate, each rolls a D6 and the lower sets up first.
To open a locked door a Thief needs only to pass an Initiative test.
When the warband rolls for Treasures after the game, it gets one more Treasure for each Thief who fought and wasn't taken out of action.

Before each battle a warband with Cooks gathers one batch of provisions. It may feast only after a battle it won, not one it lost: when it sells Treasures it counts as one size band smaller for each batch eaten (10-12 members count as 7-9). It may eat as many batches as it likes, but never counts as smaller than 1-3 models.

flags.what: A Halfling Rogues warband needs at least 3 models: our templates hold no minimum, so it is not imported. No henchmen group sizes are printed.
The Halfling maximum (M4 WS5 BS7 S3 T3 W3 I9 A4 Ld10) is our Halfling race's.

The fighters' headings aren't in the text layer: each is named from Choice of Warriors and his profile row, and priced from the hire line above it. The Chef's profile row reads Master Chef; he is named Chef, as in Choice of Warriors, the skill table and his Hot Pot rule.
The skill table's ticks read from where the text layer places them: no Hero ticks Combat or Strength.

Cleaver (counts as axe) links our Cleaver (-1 to the armour save, as an axe) at 10 gc. Pitchfork (counts as Trident) is our Trident shown as Pitchfork, Kitchenware (counts as throwing stars) our Throwing Knives/Stars shown as Kitchenware, Club/Mace our Club, Mace or Hammer. Cooking pot/Helmet is our Helmet at 10 gc, shown as Cooking pot (William, 6 Nov 2026: "the halfling cooks cooking pot is still just a regular helmet, just a cheaper initial price, should just be a personal label").
Short sword is our Sword, shown as Short sword (William, 6 Nov 2026: "short sword is just a sword i think?"), not the Bretonnian Chapel Guard's Shortsword.

The Magic Acorn is 100 gc on the list; its entry (p3) prints 250 gc, Rare 15, as ours. The 100 is the Militant Mootlanders' price before their first battle (William, 6 Nov 2026: "it is 100 just for the mootlanders on initial buy"): the line keeps 100, a list price, which the app keeps to the starting warband. Steel cloth is 35 gc on the list (ours 75 gc, Rare 13; the PDF prints no entry).

The special skills are our Militant Mootlanders group's six, worded from this PDF; their names are a heading font the text layer drops, read from p3's image. Our Looter gives "one additional Treasure or Wyrdstone Shard" (the PDF: one more Treasure) and is kept (William, 6 Nov 2026: "just keep ours"). Our Taunt is worded for the Ostlanders ("the Ostlander has learned..."), so the group's Taunt is its own, Taunt (Militant Mootlanders), in our skills data's MiM wording (William: "sure unless its specific"; overrides.json skill_splits).

The Wild Mountain Goat is a stub: 85 gc, Rare 12, Halflings only, profile M7 WS2 BS0 S2 T3 W1 I4 A1 Ld5. Its rules are on p3: Ride Mountain Goat lets a Hero with the Animal Handling skill and Scale Sheer Surfaces climb while riding, up to twice the mount's Movement.
The Chef's Hot Pot is a Leadership test before each battle: a 2D6 pre-battle roll (prebattle-rolls.json).

Thieves are henchmen here (0-3, 20 gc). Their Infiltration ("See the Skaven special skill"), Pick Locks and Cutpurse are their own rules, worded as the skills. Uneasy Allies' 1 says "Do not add additional Treasures if any Thieves remain": kept as printed.
